RAM/ROM TEST If any of the Rams or Roms are faulty, the following information will be displayed on the screen:
BAD ROM LOCATION CODE BAD RAM LOCATION CODE
Bad W Ram-0 4M Bad W Ram-1 4R
CONTROL PANEL AND COIN SWITCH TEST
To verify operation of any switch, close switch in question. If switch is operating Properly, agame sound will emit when closure is made.
Caution: Be sure to return test switch to game mode when all tests are completed.
